meta.ambition: Take the customer-service assistant that works and get the same result in three more places, without the eighteen months it took the first time.

shape.inprod: Yes — and we can name it

q15s.t: Head of CX and the platform team, 19 Aug
q15s.x: The service assistant is evaluated properly: containment rate, escalation quality and CSAT tracked weekly against a held-back set, with a named owner. It took them a year to get here and they know it.

q13s.x: Two agentic workflows are being piloted in fulfilment. The governance that covers the service assistant does not mention agents at all, and nobody has decided whether it should.

q12s.t: Asked across CX, merchandising, supply chain and finance
q12s.x: Real in customer service, experimental in merchandising, nothing anywhere else. The pattern is that AI has spread where the CX director has personally pushed it and nowhere she has not.

d15.well: Genuinely strong, and the best thing in this assessment. Weekly evaluation against a held-back set, tracked by a named owner, with escalation quality measured rather than assumed. Most organisations claim this; you can show it.
d15.improve: It exists for one system. Nothing says how the second one gets the same treatment, and the fulfilment agents currently have none of it.
d15.riskNot: The second system will be evaluated by whoever happens to care, which is how the first one nearly failed.
d15.why: You have the practice. What you do not have is a way to make it the default, and that is the difference between one success and four.

d13.well: The restraint on the customer-facing side is deliberate and correct.
d13.improve: Two agentic workflows are in pilot in fulfilment and the governance that covers your assistant does not mention agents. Nobody has decided whether it should — that decision is now overdue rather than premature.
d13.riskNot: Agents reach production under governance written for something else.
d13.riskGo: This is the one thing that would undo an otherwise well-run programme.
d13.why: You are about to repeat, in fulfilment, the mistake you spent a year fixing in customer service.

d12.well: Customer service is genuinely operational and the value is measured.
d12.improve: Spread has tracked one director's personal energy rather than any mechanism. Merchandising is experimenting; supply chain and finance have nothing.
d12.riskNot: When she moves on, so does the programme.
d12.why: The ceiling on this is not capability, it is that nothing makes it spread except one person.
